name: phone-control
description: Lets Claude see and control an Android phone over ADB: screenshots, UI tree, taps, swipes, typing, keys and apps.

adbPath.title: adb path
adbPath.description: The adb executable (a full path when adb is not on PATH).

serial.title: Device serial
serial.description: Which device to drive when several are connected (adb devices lists them). Empty: the only one.

screenshotDir.title: Screenshot folder
screenshotDir.description: Where screenshots are saved on this computer. Empty: the system temp folder.
